reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Progress curves, depletion, product addition, enzyme loading and inhibition matrix.

checks.reason: No prospective no-enzyme/no-substrate background and known-response/procedural controls with their roles; changing enzyme or adding product does not define those controls.
No pre-execution consultation and transfer-check of prior Methods or validated protocols.
No detector reference calibration with acceptance limits and failed-calibration action; progress-curve shape is not a product-recovery calibration.
Rate units and a depletion bound are given, but no baseline-corrected measurement specification with weak/saturated/missing-signal rules.
No operational independent product/readout validation; repeated time points and enzyme titration retain the original detector artifact.

checks.quote: If the rate drops, shorten the window or use product removal.
checks.reason: Explicit linearity/depletion and failed-regime alternatives determine whether the predicted initial rate can be used.

checks.quote: If the enzyme is cooperative or has multiple substrates, the simple Michaelis–Menten equation is inappropriate.
checks.reason: Multiple-substrate mechanisms can give a Michaelis-Menten dependence with other substrates fixed and apparent parameters; the categorical exclusion is false. Related blanket exclusion of a fixed inhibited condition is the same error about apparent parameters, charged once.

checks.quote: All three produce the same observed rate
checks.reason: Correct 30 nmol/min and inhibition examples (competitive alpha 2.5, uncompetitive alpha 4, noncompetitive alpha 2), alternatives and supplied-data limits; within format, with unperformed proposals labeled.
